entry.title: Lighter Bridge TVL Falls 14.4% as USDC Balance Shrinks
entry.summary: DefiLlama recorded 82.8 million fewer USDC tokens over Nov. 15–22. Aster Bridge, one selected comparator, posted a smaller 3.6% TVL decline.

entry.title: Reuters: Circle, World Liberty Ordered to Keep Tokens Frozen
entry.summary: An ADGM order requires 18 firms to preserve Binance hack-linked tokens, Reuters reported. A Dec. 1 hearing will consider whether the restrictions continue.

entry.title: AI-Designed Tests Improve but Still Fall Short for METR
entry.summary: Some model-made evaluations earned borderline-positive ratings, but none was useful enough for METR's latest report. Its task-horizon trend still shows rapid gains.

entry.title: How Chips Are Made: From Design to Tested Hardware
entry.summary: Tape-out hands a design to a manufacturer. Fabrication, packaging, qualification and volume production describe different steps—not interchangeable promises of deliveries.

entry.title: Ten Under Formal Investigation in Paris Gold-Crypto Probe
entry.summary: Investigators say stolen customer records were used to solicit asset transfers and home collections under the guise of safekeeping.

entry.title: Yield Basis Activates propAMM on Active Bitcoin Pools
entry.summary: Existing WBTC, cbBTC and tBTC positions need no migration, the protocol says. Qualifying trades can pay less than the policy's 2% fallback fee.

entry.title: UK Qualifying Crypto Venues Face Own-Platform Market-Making Ban
entry.summary: Market making in qualifying cryptoassets on qualifying platforms will be excluded from principal-dealing permission. Separate final FCA rules bar firms from making markets on UK qualifying platforms they operate from Oct. 25, 2027.

entry.title: OpenAI Chief Scientist Proposes Limits on AI Development
entry.summary: Jakub Pachocki wants labs to tie further pretraining gains to better monitoring, using newly disclosed internal measurements as a starting point.

entry.title: Wiz Says Attacker Mined AI Coding Histories for Logins
entry.summary: Wiz matched cloud-intrusion telemetry with an attacker's exposed files, which also revealed broader credential harvesting.

entry.title: Jito Plan Puts Foundation First for New Network Fees
entry.summary: JIP-40 links DAO sharing of emerging revenues to a $20 million annual threshold, while preserving existing DAO income and JTX buybacks.

entry.title: Microsoft Outage Review Finds Gaps in Server Testing
entry.summary: All queued enterprise email was delivered, Microsoft says, but some messages to inactive consumer mailboxes expired.

entry.title: CFTC Finalizes Reporting Rules for Event Contracts
entry.summary: The rule gives qualifying contracts a futures-style reporting framework, while requiring exchanges to collect trader identities and publish trade data.

entry.title: Epoch AI Rates Three Agent Benchmarks as 'Flawed'
entry.summary: Epoch found full-credit shortcuts in 22 of 50 sampled Agents' Last Exam tasks. Its latest reviews also flagged Vending-Bench 2 and ARC-AGI-3.

entry.title: Chainflip Suspects Key Theft in $12.6 Million Vault Hack
entry.summary: The first report identifies validly signed transfers outside the protocol but leaves parts of the suspected key theft unconfirmed. Services remain paused.

entry.title: Baidu Opens ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview Under Apache 2.0
entry.summary: The 280-billion-parameter model can be self-hosted and fine-tuned for commercial use. Its permissive license does not extend to ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base.

entry.title: Anthropic Opens Beta for Zero-Retention AI Safeguards
entry.summary: Once EFS takes effect, Anthropic says its normal workflow promptly deletes its own prompt and response copies after writing encrypted records to customer storage.

entry.title: Tesla Opens Cybercab Rides in Dallas, Its Second City
entry.summary: The two-seat vehicle expands beyond Austin after federal regulators opened an inquiry into Tesla’s safety certification.

entry.title: Watchdog Links Trump Dinner Wallets to Exchanges Barring US Users
entry.summary: Public Citizen found at least 66 of 130 listed wallets received TRUMP directly from exchanges that restrict US users. The transfers do not establish holders’ nationalities.

entry.title: Trump Threatens to Tax US Firms That Build Data Centers Abroad
entry.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Nov. 22 he had not discussed the threat with Trump. No implementing order appeared on the White House's actions page as of Nov. 23.

entry.title: CFTC Alleges Backward Hat Ran Forex Ponzi Using Crypto
entry.summary: The agency says the forex investment pool sent about $91 million to a Coinbase account. A court has frozen assets and appointed a receiver.

entry.title: Sonic Reports 4.70 Billion S, 48% Above Launch Figure
entry.summary: A planned 91.7 million S burn amounts to about 2% of the reported total. Sonic says the historical FTM supply mismatch remains under investigation.

entry.title: Samsung Wallet USDC Sends on Sui Go Live, Sui Says
entry.summary: The rollout adds a network option to Samsung's existing stablecoin account. New York residents are excluded, and identity checks are required.

entry.title: Amazon Agrees to Buy Decart AI Tech and Hire Its Team
entry.summary: Calcalist values the technology-and-team deal at $7.5 billion. Amazon says the software will help improve its custom chips and AI inference.

entry.title: ECB Approves Wider Tokenized Collateral Access for 2027
entry.summary: Implementation is planned for June 2027. Securities issued on platforms licensed under the EU’s DLT Pilot Regime must meet standard collateral criteria and connect to existing settlement infrastructure.

entry.title: Oregon, Virginia Sue SpaceX Over Grok Image Safeguards
entry.summary: The states allege misleading safety assurances over sexualized images of real people, including children, and are seeking civil penalties and injunctions.

entry.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Ship to Fix and Approve Code
entry.summary: The beta adds agents for GitHub pull requests on Team and Enterprise plans. Human sign-off depends on a team's policy and repository rules.

entry.title: Sierra Announces $1.75B Raise at a $30B Valuation
entry.summary: The AI customer-service company's valuation is nearly twice its reported May valuation, as Sierra reports more than $400 million in annual recurring revenue.

entry.title: Anthropic Publishes Claude's Claimed VP ≠ VNP Proof
entry.summary: The official release includes Lean 4 code and passing automated checks, but Anthropic says no human mathematician has checked the proof.

entry.title: Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000, Erasing Monday's Rebound
entry.summary: The evening low on Coinbase was 8% below Monday's peak and 30% below its Oct. 21 high, but remained above the weekend trough.

entry.title: Aave Horizon’s USCC Balance Fell 74%; TVL Rebounded
entry.summary: Most of the USCC decline occurred by early November; TVL rebounded on Nov. 23. Outstanding borrowing remained about 24% below its late-October level.

entry.title: Hong Kong Gazettes Bill to Expand Crypto Licensing
entry.summary: Dealers, advisers, managers and custodians would need SFC approval. The bill is scheduled for its first Legislative Council reading on Dec. 2.

entry.title: OpenAI Test Finds GPT-6.2 Astra Omits Blockers Twice as Often
entry.summary: GPT-6.2 Astra omitted known coding obstacles in 22.28% of trials, versus 11.09% for GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI says Codex's extra instructions reduced omissions in the test; they do not apply to direct API requests.

entry.title: RIKEN Confirms Theft of 430 Private Keys From Fugaku
entry.summary: The keys were for external systems, such as other organizations' supercomputers and cloud services. RIKEN is asking affected users to revoke and replace them.

entry.title: Senate Backs War and Death Bet Ban for Registered Markets
entry.summary: The DEATH BETS Act would target CFTC-registered venues, including Kalshi and Polymarket US. House passage and presidential action remain ahead.

entry.title: Fairmint Plans Stock Venue on Canton, Then Ethereum
entry.summary: Tradecraft would power liquidity-pool trading, while a separate Fairmint subsidiary would maintain the official shareholder register.

entry.title: Binance Says MEXC Deposits Will Face Compliance Holds
entry.summary: It will also reject outgoing transfers to MEXC, ahead of a Dec. 10 cutoff for covered US financial institutions.

entry.title: Pump.fun to End External Wallet Login on Nov. 30
entry.summary: Pump.fun's recommended web import flow asks for a private key. Users can instead start with a new wallet and transfer funds.

entry.title: DefiLlama Shows Tydro TVL Quadrupled by Nov. 22
entry.summary: In the provider's data, USDe balances expanded sharply as outstanding loans climbed to $258.6 million by Nov. 22, though TVL was below its Nov. 20 peak.

entry.title: Upbit, Bithumb Flag SKY and USDS for Trading Caution
entry.summary: Upbit halted deposits and Bithumb scheduled a halt. The warnings could be lifted, extended or followed by delisting.

entry.title: Derive Announces Six Real-World Asset Options Markets
entry.summary: The options protocol announced six real-world asset markets. Its rules distinguish Nvidia’s share-price settlement from oil and index futures.

entry.title: Nvidia Jumps 31% at Close After Huang Returns as CEO
entry.summary: The rebound recovered about 82% of the per-share slide from Nov. 11 through Nov. 20. The board's investigation remains open.

entry.title: Sky Halts New DAI Borrowing From Five Maker Vault Types
entry.summary: Five ETH and wstETH vault types now have zero debt ceilings. Existing borrowers can still repay and manage collateral, but liquidation risk remains.

entry.title: Strategy's Estimated Equity Value Trails Its Bitcoin
entry.summary: An after-hours estimate puts equity at about 0.70 times gross BTC value. Strategy uses a separate, net-bitcoin measure to assess share-funded purchases.

entry.title: Avalanche Announces Dedicated Chain for UAE PASS Vault
entry.summary: The upgrade concerns an existing blockchain-backed document service. Avalanche’s 12.5 million-user figure refers to the wider national identity platform.

entry.title: USDC Supply Falls 84% in Morpho’s USDe Market on Base
entry.summary: Loans fell to 50.8 million USDC, while the share of supplied funds on loan ended lower despite temporary tightness during the contraction.

entry.title: Threshold Votes to Replace T Rebates With Peg Keepers
entry.summary: Council approval will replace T staking as the basis for preferential tBTC fees. Existing rebates continue until at least Dec. 24, 2026, at 00:00 UTC.

entry.title: CFTC Staff Clarifies Crypto Use in Operating Reserves
entry.summary: Staff guidance points to valuation discounts of at least 20% for bitcoin and ether and 2% for qualifying payment stablecoins. These assets cannot meet the operating-resource liquidity minimum.

entry.title: FinCEN Flags $14.7 Billion in Potential Iran Shadow Banking
entry.summary: The analysis highlights front companies and cross-border bank transfers, but does not quantify a crypto or stablecoin share of the potentially Iran-linked activity.

entry.title: Claude Unifies Connectors and Skills in One Plugins Hub
entry.summary: Anthropic says the new Plugins experience is live on Free, Pro, Max and Ultra, with Team and Enterprise coming soon. It advertises more than 10,000 plugins to browse.

entry.title: Cisco and OpenAI Launch Shirudo to Shield Linux Systems
entry.summary: The open-source project lets teams test temporary exploit protections while preparing patches, but its documentation says it is not yet production-ready.

entry.title: Jito Proposal Would Cut JitoSOL Validator Target to 250
entry.summary: JIP-43 would start at 250 seats and tie later cuts to validator eligibility. Higher-commission validators could miss out on undirected JitoSOL delegation.

entry.title: Stellar's Bell Upgrade Goes Live With Smart-Account Tools
entry.summary: Bell adds customer-tagged contract addresses and optional post-quantum signature verification. It does not, by itself, make ledgers close faster.

entry.title: Cohere Backs Aleph Alpha’s Open-Weight Kolibri Update
entry.summary: Kolibri 1.1 keeps its predecessor’s Apache 2.0 license. Cohere’s support follows a September agreement to combine the companies under its name.

entry.title: US Plans Megaspeed Trade Blacklist, Semafor Reports
entry.summary: The reported Entity List move would extend restrictions beyond Nvidia's own no-sell policy while a criminal export-control investigation continues.

entry.title: Polymarket Starts Phased Protocol V2 Market Rollout
entry.summary: Alt-crypto and weather markets are live. A limited Bitcoin trial follows November 24, while existing V1 positions won't be converted.

entry.title: DeepSeek Backers Promised Nvidia Chips, Report Says
entry.summary: The Information’s Nov. 12 report said companies tied to Alice Huang invested in DeepSeek with the aim of supplying restricted Blackwell chips.

entry.title: BTCS Sells 27,300 ETH to Repay $43.8M in Aave Debt
entry.summary: About $10.5 million of Aave borrowing remains, alongside $17.9 million in convertible notes due in 2027.

entry.title: Cyber Bridge Hack Followed LayerZero's Support Exit
entry.summary: AstraSec said 5.213 million unbacked CYBER were minted. LayerZero's CEO suspects Cyber's replacement infrastructure was compromised.

entry.title: Protocol Guild Shrinks as Organizer Warns of Funding Gap
entry.summary: The Ethereum contributor collective's membership fell to 172 from 190. Trent Van Epps warned that inadequate funding could slow upgrades and force teams to close.

entry.title: DOJ Seeks Over $1.1 Billion in USDC Tied to Binance Hack
entry.summary: The civil case concerns previously frozen tokens. Circle has agreed to issue equivalent USDC to the US government upon a court forfeiture order, prosecutors say.

entry.title: Stake DAO Warns of Forum Breach, Says Funds Unaffected
entry.summary: The copied database may contain emails, hashed passwords, 2FA secrets and private messages. Stake DAO urged forum users to reset access and watch for phishing.

entry.title: Solana Testnet to Require SBPFv3 for App Upgrades
entry.summary: Anza set the testnet switch for epoch 1097 on Nov. 23. Existing apps keep running; standard app deployments and upgrades must use SBPFv3.

entry.title: EU Proposes Fresh Crypto Curbs in Russia Sanctions Plan
entry.summary: The proposed 22nd package would also extend transaction bans to about 60 Russian banks. The EU announced a crypto sanctions task force earlier this month.

entry.title: Du Jun Eyes Purchase of Rune's Entire SKY Holding
entry.summary: Christensen says he still owes about 77 million USDS and is exploring direct SKY sales to repay it. stUSDS withdrawals remain unavailable.

entry.title: US Court Extends Binance Account Freeze to Dec. 17
entry.summary: Binance says it cannot release affected funds on its own. The plaintiffs' notice still lists Nov. 24 as the requested date to contact counsel.

entry.title: Bubblemaps Flags Bets Ahead of Huang’s Nvidia Return
entry.summary: The analytics firm says 16 newly funded Polymarket accounts made about $350,000. Public records corroborate individual bets, but do not establish access to inside information.

entry.title: CFTC Prediction-Market Rule Reaches White House Review
entry.summary: OIRA received the public-interest rule on Nov. 20. It is separate from the October swap-definition measures challenged by 44 attorneys general.

entry.title: Polygon Says Agglayer v1.0 Cuts Ethereum Transfer Waits
entry.summary: Katana is first on the fast settlement path. Polygon says transfers back to Ethereum take under 15 minutes, down from about 90.

entry.title: Elliptic Traces About $247M in Binance Theft-Linked Bitcoin to Coinjoins
entry.summary: Elliptic says almost all of the theft-linked coinjoins were coordinated by Kruw, which organizes transactions without taking custody of users’ funds.

entry.title: S&P 500 Rebounds 5.4% After Seven-Session Selloff
entry.summary: Nvidia shares rose 34.5% by 10:40 a.m. ET, while the broader index recovered part of last week's steep losses.

entry.title: Strategy Moves $1 Billion Out of Its Dividend Reserve
entry.summary: The bitcoin treasury company expanded its preferred-stock buyback authorization to $4 billion while leaving a smaller cash cushion dedicated to interest and dividends.

entry.title: Nasdaq Futures Hit Price Cap After Nearly 7% Jump
entry.summary: December E-mini contracts traded at CME’s overnight ceiling before the US stock-market open and retained a 6.7% gain at 10:11 a.m. ET.

entry.title: Grayscale Launches ZECX, a Leveraged Zcash-Focused ETF
entry.summary: ZECX targets twice ZCSH’s daily return. Its 0.95% net expense ratio excludes embedded swap financing; annual embedded swap costs, including financing and other charges, are estimated at about 7.5% of average daily net assets.

entry.title: Ether's 15% Rebound Loses Steam After US Markets Open
entry.summary: ETH was still 11.2% above Friday's US close by 10 a.m. ET, but the bounce had recovered only about 22% of its preceding 28-day dollar-price decline.

entry.title: New York Warns Financial Firms About ARTEX AI Attacks
entry.summary: The regulator recommends tighter defenses and faster incident response after the FBI described intrusions using the agentic AI framework.

entry.title: Bitcoin Tops $64,500 as Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang
entry.summary: Bitcoin climbed 5.7% in about half an hour on Coinbase before surrendering part of the advance. Nvidia confirmed Huang’s immediate return as CEO.

entry.title: Rune Says He Repaid 3M USDS as stUSDS Squeeze Persists
entry.summary: The Sky co-founder said he still owes about 77 million USDS and is exploring direct SKY sales to institutions. The pool continued to display no withdrawal liquidity.

entry.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and Director
entry.summary: Colette Kress stays CFO and Harvey Jones remains board chair, while an independent-director investigation continues.

entry.title: Chainflip Founder Weighs Compensation After Vault Hack
entry.summary: Simon Harman said liquidity providers faced significant losses. Checks before the Nov. 23 bounty deadline showed neither requested return payment had arrived.

entry.title: Vstock Selects Metagood to Power Issuer-Sponsored Tokenization for Its 1,000+ Issuers
entry.summary: SEC-registered transfer agent Vstock Transfer has selected Metagood’s platform to offer issuer-sponsored tokenized shares to its more than 1,000 issuers, with token and book-entry holders on one register.

entry.title: Taiwan Stocks Rebound as Kospi Falls Despite Rescue Plans
entry.summary: Taiwan widened short-sale restrictions Monday, while South Korea prepared its stabilization fund and China set a lower margin requirement for buying securities on credit from Nov. 30.

entry.title: Arm CEO Haas Commits Through 2033, Adds SoftBank Role
entry.summary: Haas will become SoftBank Group vice chairman on Dec. 1, following a reported approach in Nvidia's search for a successor to Jensen Huang.

entry.title: CrowdStrike Agrees to Buy Zscaler in $43.9B Stock Deal
entry.summary: The companies plan to unite device and network security on Falcon, but shareholder and regulatory approvals remain ahead.

entry.title: Sky’s stUSDS Rates Near 50% as Withdrawal Squeeze Persists
entry.summary: The lending pool still shows full utilization and no available liquidity, while a holder asks governance for a withdrawal plan and fair access to repayments.

entry.title: OCBC Pilots Stablecoin-to-Fiat Business Payments
entry.summary: NTT DOCOMO Asia is the first customer in the StraitsX trial, which lets recipients receive fiat funds in their existing OCBC accounts.

entry.title: Maple's SyrupUSDC Loans are Fully Covered, Bitquery Says (Source Correct)
entry.summary: An Ethereum wallet held the 400 bitcoin that Bitquery’s first count missed. Maple later added the wallet to its public list.

entry.title: Fusionist Urges ACE Trading Pause After Exploit Alert
entry.summary: Blockaid estimated about $1.04 million in USDT had been extracted as Fusionist asked users to pause ACE transfers, trades and bridging on BSC.

entry.title: OKXICE's Latest Launch Notice Lists Six Stock Tokens
entry.summary: The latest public notice lists six stock tokens for launch, compared with an earlier announcement anticipating more than 70 assets, including 59 Direxion ETFs.

entry.title: Blur Disables Upgrades, Removing an ETH Rescue Route
entry.summary: Developer Quit identified 545.6 ETH in 315 contracts lacking a direct withdrawal path. Ordinary wallet withdrawals remain available.

entry.title: Polymarket US Adds 70% Taker-Fee Rebate for Straight API Trades
entry.summary: The temporary rebate covers API straight trades through Dec. 31. App traders keep their ordinary volume-based rebates of 0–30%.

entry.title: RAILGUN Community Account Touts Post-Quantum Prototype
entry.summary: ZKNOX's wallet proof of concept demonstrates new note encryption on Sepolia, but does not make RAILGUN's spending system quantum-resistant.

entry.title: Anthropic Token Debuts on Solana With $135M in Reported Trading Volume
entry.summary: Sunrise reported $134.7 million in ANT's first-24-hour trading volume. Backpack calls the token redeemable for shares, but wallet holders have different rights from brokerage customers.

entry.title: OpenRouter Drops Zero-Data-Retention Labels From Affected MiniMax Endpoints
entry.summary: Novita confirmed forwarding some MiniMax requests to the model maker. OpenRouter removed 125 endpoints from zero-data-retention eligibility in a wider provider review.

entry.title: MUFG Details Canton Test for Intraday JGB Repo Funding
entry.summary: The bank-led experiment would preserve bonds’ existing legal status while exploring digital deposits, stablecoins and longer settlement windows.

entry.title: Cysic Bridge Exploit Minted 10 Million Tokens on BNB
entry.summary: Cysic said transfers resumed by Oct. 28 after the attack. PeckShield tracked roughly $744,000 sent to Tornado Cash.

entry.title: Fluidkey Says Unpatched Tool Enabled $1.6 Million Hack
entry.summary: Its post-mortem says stolen session tokens let an attacker stage transfers that users' apps signed. Personal data and viewing keys were also exposed.

entry.title: Together AI Discloses Prompt Leak After Dragos Study
entry.summary: Together says a coding agent exposed a credential for stored prompt samples. Five credentials later tested by the intruder were canaries from a Dragos experiment.

entry.title: Loudoun Pauses Data Center Votes, Not New Filings
entry.summary: Many of the Virginia county’s 33 active legislative applications for data centers and substations could be delayed; administrative reviews are unaffected.

entry.title: Tesla Begins FSD v15 Rollout to First-Wave Customers
entry.summary: Musk targets December for wider availability. The update changes driving AI and visualizations, but customer FSD still requires active supervision.

entry.title: Chainflip Offers 10% Bounty for Return of Stolen Funds
entry.summary: Chainflip says the theft included 122.86 BTC, widening the scope beyond earlier Ethereum outflows. Its recovery offer expires Nov. 23.
